description: Touch-anywhere floating virtual joystick for React canvas games, a pure deadzone/normalize function, and an opt-in keyboard co-map.
rules: FloatingJoystick is touch-only unless allowMouse is set, and it claims exactly one pointer at a time.
Mark any control that must keep its own taps inside the joystick host with data-joystick-ignore.
normalizeJoystick is pure: offsets inside the deadzone report zero magnitude, offsets beyond the radius clamp to a unit vector.
The accent prop is explicit; the component never reads a host CSS custom property.
useKeyboardVectorMap is opt-in and emits a plain {x, y} vector, so it composes with the same handler as FloatingJoystick.onChange.
